# literary-critic

> Lets an LLM read a full novel manuscript the way a professional editor would, across many chat sessions and drafts.

literary-critic indexes the manuscript into stable anchors and a knowledge base (the Codex), runs a catalogue of editorial checks with evidence tied to the text, and turns the findings into prioritised revision rounds. The writer writes: the tool diagnoses and explains, and changes the manuscript only with the writer's approval for each change.
